notes: Fixed heavy FPS lag with tracker cards on the HUD: they're now worked out a few times a second instead of every frame
The craft plan HUD no longer rebuilds every item icon from your storage every 2 seconds, just the counts
Saving your storage and item icons happens in the background, so the game no longer freezes while those big files are written
The garden visitor helper no longer looks through all your storage every frame
Drops in chat with a repeat counter from a chat-compacting mod, like "x64 (2)", are counted properly
